Dig a hole in the *jungle* to hide,
So you dig *sideways* into a hill, sloping the floor *up,* so rain runs out.
But soldiers find your hole and drop a *grenade* down it.
So every tunnel *zigzags,* and the blast hits the *wall,*
So the tunnel dips under a *pool of water* and back up.
So you hide *sharp bamboo* under a *fake floor.*
So you rub each hole with the soldiers' own *soap,*
But sooner or later, they'll find *every entrance.*
So you dig one at the *bottom of the river.*
